fact: As of December 2024 Benin's SIPAO is administered by the Centre de documentation de sécurité publique (CDSP), under the Ministry of Justice and Legislation, which is the country's data collection and registration centre (DACORE) and each year extends the system into law-enforcement services and trains operators of digital terminals and validators; decree 2024-877 of 11 April 2024 sets the rules for processing police, judicial and prison information, and standard operating procedures validated in November 2023 were being disseminated in the departments from October 2024.
title: Lettre d’information SIPAO, numéro 25-26, décembre 2024
